card.fact_statement: 2024 YR4 was discovered at the Chilean station in Río Hurtado.
card.source_span: The asteroid was discovered by the Chilean station of the Asteroid Terrestrial-impact Last Alert System (ATLAS) at Río Hurtado on 27 December 2024.

card.fact_statement: 2025 GN1 was discovered at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory.
card.source_span: 2025 GN1 is an Atira-type near-Earth asteroid discovered by the Dark Energy Camera (DECam) at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory on 4 April 2025.
